organization: Illinois Attorney General (copy of Public Act 91-0230)
title: Home Repair and Remodeling Act, Public Act 91-0230 (as enacted)
claim: Defines home repair and remodeling as work on residences (≤6 units) other than maintenance/service/repairs under $500; excludes carpet cleaning/repair, merchant appliance installation, and landscaping. Written contract required for work over $1,000; 'Home Repair: Know Your Consumer Rights' pamphlet required for all contracts (signed acknowledgment over $1,000). Section 25 requires liability insurance of $100,000 per person / $300,000 per occurrence bodily injury, $50,000 property damage, $10,000 improper repairs (unless net worth ≥$1M). No state registration/licence created.
excerpt: other than maintenance, service, or repairs under $500 ... does not include ... landscaping
limitations: As-enacted 1999 text; later amendments (e.g., current insurance amounts, cancellation rights for seniors) not verified because ilga.gov returned HTTP 503 during research.

title: Home Repair consumer protection page
claim: Contractors must present the Home Repair Consumer Rights document for work of $1,000+; consumers have 3 business days to cancel contracts signed at home, 15 business days if over 65.
excerpt: Customers have three business days to cancel ... Customers over 65 have 15 business days (paraphrase)
limitations: Consumer-facing summary; no registration or insurance detail.

title: Child Care Licensure
claim: Since July 1, 2026 IDEC (not DCFS) is lead agency for child care licensing; rules moved from 89 Ill. Adm. Code 406/407/408 to 23 Ill. Adm. Code 2007/2008/2009. Licensed family child care: up to 8 children (12 with assistant); group home 12+ with qualified assistant; license-exempt up to 3 children; centre ratios from 4:1 infants to 20:1 age 5+. Fingerprint ISP/FBI, CANTS and sex-offender checks; annual unannounced visits.
excerpt: Starting July 1, 2026, the Illinois Department of Early Childhood officially became the lead agency for Child Care Licensing.
limitations: Director qualifications, fees, timeline not on page.
